governanceRename.rationale: Per SKYLINE 2026-06-28 R3.0 Final Continuous Execution Directive §2.D, the R3.0D 5-phase production sequence is Evidence Graph → Hypothesis Engine → Priority Engine → Engineer Brief + UI + Activation. The pre-existing D2..D5 checkpoint names (D2_HYPOTHESIS_ENGINE / D3_PRIORITY_ENGINE / D4_ENGINEER_BRIEF / D5_ACTIVATION) were design intent at D0_BOOTSTRAP and explicitly described in the original schema.json note as 'D1..D5 are NOT yet authorized — they describe future intent so the validator can refuse premature activation'. The directive supersedes that intent. D2 introduces the rename atomically alongside the first Evidence Graph production code; no historic checkpoint manifest (only D0.json + D1.json exist) is rewritten.

contractEnforcements.evidenceGraphScope: renderer/js/r3-0d-evidence-graph.js is the SINGLE new production path authorized at D2. It consumes ONLY D1 contract-validated sanitized snapshots (R3_0D_EvidenceNodeContract.validateEvidenceNodeShape); the original caller object is never referenced after validation.
contractEnforcements.deepFreezeOutput: The returned graph and every nested array / object is Object.freeze'd. Caller mutation post-build cannot reach into the graph.
contractEnforcements.deterministicOrdering: Same sanitized input produces identical graphId, identical node order (sorted by nodeId), identical edge order (sorted by from/to/kind), identical topological order, identical correlation order, identical dedup summary. Clock is INJECTABLE via opts.clock(); createdAt depends on the clock; graphId is INDEPENDENT of the clock.
contractEnforcements.edgeKindClosed: Closed enum {supports, contradicts, derived_from, correlated_with, invalidates}. D2 emits only supports / contradicts (from per-node fields) + correlated_with (single canonical direction, from < to). derived_from + invalidates are reserved for future input shapes.
contractEnforcements.cycleDetection: DFS-based detection over CAUSAL edges only (supports + contradicts). correlated_with is INTENTIONALLY excluded because it is symmetric / non-causal; emitting it bidirectionally would auto-create cycles on every multi-metric source. Any cycle in causal edges → fail-closed EVIDENCE_GRAPH_CYCLE.
contractEnforcements.orphanEdgeRejection: supportingEdges / contradictingEdges targeting an unknown nodeId → fail-closed EVIDENCE_GRAPH_ORPHAN. The whole build is rejected; no partial graph is returned.
contractEnforcements.duplicateAndSemanticDedup: (a) duplicate nodeId → first kept, second rejected as EVIDENCE_DUPLICATE_ID; (b) semantic fingerprint (case + session + lap + sourceId + sourceVersion + category + observation.kind/channel/i18nKey/params, EXCLUDING nodeId and freshness and credibility/provenance/availability) → first kept, second rejected as EVIDENCE_GRAPH_DUPLICATED_SOURCE_DOUBLECOUNT.
contractEnforcements.correlationGrouping: Nodes sharing (caseId, sessionId, lapId, sourceId) are placed in ONE correlation group with independenceWeight = 1 / groupSize. D2 marks correlation; D3 priority engine consumes it (no confidence computation at D2).
contractEnforcements.associationBinding: Every sanitized node's identity.caseId / sessionId MUST equal envelope.caseAssociation; cross-lap pollution (lap-scoped envelope ≠ lap-scoped node) is rejected per node and counted in rejectedReasonsSummary.
contractEnforcements.importedSummaryElevationGuard: An evidence node with identity.sourceId === 'imported_summary' MUST NOT carry credibility === 'measured'. Rejected as EVIDENCE_IMPORTED_SUMMARY_ELEVATION_FORBIDDEN.
contractEnforcements.envelopeDefenceShallow: Envelope validation is shallow on rawEvidence (Array.prototype + length cap) so a single caller-supplied hostile evidence node fails THAT node only (counted in rejectedReasonsSummary) and does not poison the whole envelope. Per-node validation runs the full RC.isOriginalPlainObject + hasHiddenOwnKey + hasNonPlainNestedObject defence + D1 validateEvidenceNodeShape sanitization.
contractEnforcements.outerTryCatch: buildEvidenceGraph is wrapped in an outer try/catch. Any internal throw collapses to INTERNAL_CONTRACT_VIOLATION via RC.buildBlockedResult; never bubbles to the caller.
contractEnforcements.caps: NODES_CAP=256 (post-validation), INPUT_RAW_EVIDENCE_CAP=512 (envelope), EDGES_CAP_TOTAL=1024, CORRELATION_GROUPS_CAP=64, CANNOT_CONCLUDE_CAP=64, LIMITATIONS_CAP=64, PARAMS_KEYS_CAP=32 (per-observation; RN-09 closure), ENVELOPE_BYTE_CAP=256 KiB (post-sanitization JSON.stringify; RN-09 closure). generationToken ≤ 256 chars; contextVersion ≤ 64 chars.
contractEnforcements.noLLM: No LLM call. Deterministic JavaScript only.
contractEnforcements.noUI: No DOM mutation, no Alpine binding, no index.html script src. UI is exclusively D5_ENGINEER_BRIEF_ACTIVATION.

findings: RN-02 raw-evidence accessor poisons whole build
RN-06 clock executes before input validation

findingDetail.RN-13 round-4: Hostile clock replacing Function.prototype.call corrupted _safeSlice/_safeMap, injecting unfrozen {tampered:true} entries into nodes / correlationGroups / topologicalOrder. _ArrayPrototypeSlice.call / _ArrayPrototypeMap.call still routed through Function.prototype.call which the clock could re-bind.
findingDetail.RN-15 round-4: Lone surrogates were undercounted by _jsonStringWidth (lone low surrogate fell through to BMP 3-byte; lone high surrogate assumed paired low and was undercounted to 4 bytes). 35×30×70 lone-low-surrogate values bypassed per-node estimation (~245 KB estimated) and reached the post-canonical envelope check at 471,197 bytes.

findingDetail.RN-13 round-4: STILL-OPEN despite Round 6 direct-loop _safeSlice/_safeMap. Hostile clock installs Object.defineProperty(Array.prototype, '0', {set: ...}) — `out[i] = ...` on freshly-created out=[] invokes the prototype setter (no own descriptor at index 0 → falls through to prototype [[Set]]), which installs its own {tampered:true} data descriptor. Codex reproduced: nodes / correlationGroups / topology = [{tampered:true}], entries unfrozen.
findingDetail.RN-15 round-4: CLOSED. Lone surrogates correctly counted as 6 bytes; widths verified empty/ASCII/lone-low/lone-high/pair/mixed = 2/3/8/8/6/12.
findingDetail.RN-16: NEW. _estimateNodeUtf8Bytes approximation missed top-level structural keys / nested braces / inter-field commas — combined undercount ~300 bytes per node. 35 nodes × 30 ASCII params × 225 chars passed Step 4.5 (~256 KB estimated) and failed only at Step 17 (post-canonical) at 265,511 bytes.
findingDetail.RN-17: NEW. DEL (U+007F) was incorrectly treated as a 6-byte JSON escape. Per ES §25.5.2.2 Quote(value), only U+0000..U+001F (plus " and \) MUST be escaped — DEL passes through as 1 byte. A 35 × 30 × 70 DEL payload whose actual JSON is only 101,214 bytes (well under 256 KB cap) was over-rejected at Step 4.5.

findingDetail.RN-13 round-4: CLOSED. captured _ObjectDefineProperty bypass via [[DefineOwnProperty]] confirmed against Array.prototype['0'] setter + Object.prototype[reasonCode] setter. Codex targeted suite 157/157.
findingDetail.RN-16: STILL-OPEN via NEW attack angle. 35 same-source nodes with 30 × 195-byte params generate 35*34/2 = 595 correlated_with edges (~71 KB extra). Per-node sum at Step 4.5 ~211 KB passes; total post-canonical 264,011 bytes only caught at Step 17. Step 4.5 still does not count the edges + correlationGroups envelope contributions.
findingDetail.RN-17: CLOSED. DEL (101 KB actual) builds successfully; full char-class table verified (C1, LRM/RLM, PUA, supplementary, lone surrogates all encode correctly).

findingDetail.RN-16: CLOSED. Exact 35*30*195 same-source attack now rejects at Step 11.5 with 264,011 bytes; 35*30*190 builds with 595 edges (negative control passes).
findingDetail.RN-18: NEW. Inherited Object.prototype.toJSON installed BEFORE buildEvidenceGraph executes during Step 11.5 / Step 17 _JSONStringify calls (ES §25.5.2.2 SerializeJSONObject performs [[Get]] for toJSON on every nested object). Two attack vectors: (a) the toJSON hook can mutate the shared `edges` array AFTER Step 11's EDGE_KIND_ALLOWED enforcement → injection of an {kind:'invalid_kind'} edge ends up in the materialised graph (still frozen, but invalid kind); (b) stateful toJSON returns different sizes between Step 11.5 and Step 17, disproving the exact-equivalence claim (Step 11.5 passes at 0 bytes, Step 17 rejects at 262,159 bytes).

CLOSED. _stableStringify walks via Object.keys + manual recursion + direct primitive encoding; toJSON [[Get]] never fires (mutation / stateful-size / Array.prototype.toJSON / throwing variants all benign). Primitive strings bypass toJSON per ES §25.5.2.2 SerializeJSONProperty.
findingDetail.RN-19: NEW. _stableStringify used uncaptured `parts.join(',')` (and similarly .push / .sort) on the dynamically-built parts/keys arrays. Rebinding Array.prototype.join after module load falsified all three byte-cap measurements: a baseline 271,556-byte envelope was rejected, but the same input with the rebinding returned valid:true with 35 nodes and 595 edges.
findingDetail.RN-20: NEW. Step 14 called ambient Object.freeze(edgesOut[ei]) inside the per-element wrapping loop instead of captured _ObjectFreeze. A pre-build replacement of Object.freeze mutated the edge's `kind` field BEFORE the frozen wrap, producing a valid:true graph containing three frozen `invalid_kind` edges that bypassed Step 11's EDGE_KIND_ALLOWED enforcement.

codexVerdict.tierDisclosure: Codex D2 Round 1 BLOCK on 10766c0 (12 findings); Round 2 BLOCK on ad6474a (closed 6 / 6 still-open); Round 3 BLOCK on 63ecf69 (closed 5 + RN-13/RN-14 NEW + RN-09 partial); Round 4 BLOCK on e84d22c (closed RN-09 + RN-14 + RN-15 NEW + RN-13 still partial); Round 5 BLOCK on ec00b88 (RN-13 round-4 + RN-15 round-4 STILL-OPEN); Round 6 BLOCK on d7c045f (RN-15 round-4 CLOSED; RN-13 round-4 STILL-OPEN via Array.prototype['0'] setter; RN-16 + RN-17 NEW); Round 7 BLOCK on 90bf868 (RN-13 round-4 + RN-17 CLOSED; RN-16 STILL-OPEN via same-source 595-edge); Round 8 BLOCK on 497c143 (RN-16 CLOSED via Step 11.5 exact preview; RN-18 NEW — Object.prototype.toJSON hook invoked by _JSONStringify can mutate shared edges array OR return stateful different sizes between Step 11.5 and Step 17). Round 9 candidate switches Step 4.5 (per-node estimator) + Step 11.5 (preview check) + Step 17 (belt-and-suspenders) from _JSONStringify to _stableStringify. _stableStringify walks via captured _ObjectKeys + manual indexed array recursion + direct primitive encoding — it NEVER performs a [[Get]] for the toJSON property anywhere in the value tree, foreclosing both the mutation vector (toJSON cannot fire on the previewIdPayload reference holding the shared `edges` array) AND the stateful-size vector (toJSON is not invoked, so any installed hook is benign for byte cap purposes). _stableStringify also patched to use captured _ObjectKeys / _ArrayIsArray / _JSONStringify (the only _JSONStringify call left is on primitive strings, where ES Quote runs without any toJSON [[Get]]). Adversarial regressions added in Section T (Object.prototype.toJSON mutation / stateful-size / Array.prototype.toJSON / throwing toJSON — all fail-closed without hook firing). Tier 1 raw stdout for all eight rounds at round-{1..8}-<sha>.raw.txt.
